types.name: Mean
types.description: Asks for the arithmetic mean or average of raw, frequency or grouped data, a corrected mean after a wrong entry, a combined mean of groups, or a missing value or frequency given the mean.

types.name: Median
types.description: Asks for the median (middle value) of a list or of a grouped frequency table, or for a missing value given the median.

types.name: Mode
types.description: Asks for the mode (most frequent value) of a list, or of a grouped table using the modal class formula, or for an unknown given the mode.

types.name: Mean, median and mode relation
types.description: Gives two of mean, median and mode and asks for the third using mode = 3 median − 2 mean, or asks about symmetric and skewed data.

types.name: Range, deviation and SD
types.description: Asks for the range, mean deviation, variance, standard deviation or coefficient of variation, or how they change when every value is shifted or scaled.
